purpose: Summative artifact applying E1.1-E1.5 in 5 mini-tasks. Used as Lesson 5 capstone evidence.
student_learning_goal: I can give and follow directions to move.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can give and follow directions to move.
header.character_watermark: Trekker Tig and Compass Coco in the top-right corner with a treasure map. Small (~1.5in combined). References both characters from blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Pick a rule. Sort 6 shapes into 2 piles. Write the rule.
parts.visual_layout: 6 shape thumbnails at the top + 2 sort boxes + a 'Rule: ___' line.

image_placeholders.description: A sort layout for a Grade 1 capstone worksheet, B&W line art. Top: 6 shape thumbnails (mix of squares, triangles, circles in two sizes), each ~0.8in. Below: 2 empty sort boxes ~2.5in × 1.5in, each unlabelled (child writes pile labels). Below the boxes, a single 'My Rule: ___' line.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P1_SORT at Part 1: instructions ask the child to sort by a rule. Keywords name the activity.

parts.answer_key: Any consistent sort by a single rule. Rule could be size, shape, sides, etc.

parts.student_instructions: Draw a line of symmetry on each shape.
parts.visual_layout: Three shapes stacked vertically: square, butterfly, equilateral triangle.

image_placeholders.description: Three shapes for symmetry lines for a Grade 1 capstone worksheet, B&W line art. Square (~1.5in), butterfly (~2in), equilateral triangle (~1.5in). Each clearly outlined for the child to draw a fold line through.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P2_SYMMETRY at Part 2: instructions ask the child to draw symmetry lines. Keywords name the visual element.

parts.answer_key: Square: vertical or horizontal line through centre. Butterfly: vertical line down centre. Triangle: vertical line through apex.

parts.student_instructions: Look at the trail map. Write 3 directions to find the treasure.
parts.visual_layout: A trail map with a START square at one corner and a TREASURE square at another. Below: 3 numbered direction lines.

image_placeholders.description: A trail map for a Grade 1 capstone worksheet, B&W line art. ~5in × 3in. Grid of squares (~6 columns × 4 rows). 'START' square in the bottom-left corner with a small star icon. 'TREASURE' square in the top-right corner with a small chest icon. Visible path or grid for the child to plan the route. Below the map, 3 numbered direction lines: '1. ___', '2. ___', '3. ___'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P3_TRAIL at Part 3: instructions ask the child to write directions. Keywords name the visual elements (trail, treasure) and activity (directions).

parts.answer_key: Any valid 3-direction sequence that moves from START to TREASURE. Sample: 'forward 4, turn right, forward 3'.

parts.student_instructions: Look at the 3-block structure. List or sketch the 2D shapes you would see on its faces.
parts.visual_layout: A small 3-block tower drawn on the left; a 6-row table on the right labelled 'Face 1, Face 2, ... Face 6' for the child to write or sketch the shape.
parts.answer_key: All faces are squares (cube faces); accept rectangle if structure is rectangular prism.

parts.student_instructions: Look at the small map. Write 3 position-word sentences about it. Use words like BETWEEN, ABOVE, BELOW, NEXT TO.
parts.visual_layout: A small map showing maple tree, cabin, river, treasure-X laid out on a path. Three blank sentence lines below for the child to fill.
parts.answer_key: Sample: 'The maple is BETWEEN the cabin and the river.' / 'The treasure is NEXT TO the maple.' / 'The river is BELOW the cabin.' Accept any 3 valid position-word sentences.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, write directions backwards (TREASURE back to START).
teacher_notes: Lesson 5 capstone — summative evidence. Score against the rubric. Part 1 captures E1.1 (sorting). Part 2 captures E1.3 (symmetry). Part 3 captures E1.5 (directions). E1.2 and E1.4 captured in the lesson activities (build + locate). Children completing all 3 parts independently demonstrate full unit mastery. Parts 4 (BUILD) and 5 (LOCATE) added to map all 5 lesson stations to summative artefacts: Stations 1-3 → Parts 1-3, Station 2 BUILD → Part 4, Station 4 LOCATE → Part 5. E1.2 and E1.4 now have summative coverage.
